items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmd7: A gunman with suspected far-right ties drove into Krakow's packed main square and opened fire at random, killing six people and wounding more than a dozen; a tram was also hit but no riders were hurt. items.https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/8: El Hierro, a Canary Island of about 11,400 people, declared an emergency after more than 3,300 migrants arrived on roughly 30 boats since early November, straining shelters and the hospital. items.https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n: Paul Mackenzie, leader of Kenya's Good News International doomsday church, was sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult. items.https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed: Polish PM Donald Tusk called the Krakow shooting that killed six people and wounded 15 an act of terrorism. Three more bodies, believed to be the gunman's family members, were found at his home.

The party, ruling since apartheid ended in 1994, is projected to lose its lead in Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal as coalition talks begin.

items.https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed: Israel's president chose opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot over Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to try forming the country's next government, reflecting how opposition to Netanyahu united rival parties after an inconclusive election.
